packaged_v0.2.1.source_relation: per release record, version bump only from accepted research snapshot

model_binding.source: v0.2.1 bundled model directory copied identically into each replay arm

method.pairing: Each binary ran against a copy of the exact same retained indexed DB seed; seed hashes are listed above.
method.normalization: UUID-shaped strings and ISO UTC timestamps only; packet status, results, order, text, state, scope, and warnings otherwise compared exactly.
import_projection: doc_id used only for local output mapping
method.synthetic_parameters: Synthetic event timestamps and five-second minimum visit duration are harness inputs, not observed browsing times.
limits: Only returned packets are observable; candidate generation, admission, and rank-stage loss are not attributed.
Qrel group identity is hostname+title, a source-identity proxy; attainable recall does not model native site-agnostic payload deduplication.
The separate synthetic 10k capacity/performance probe is reported in capacity-10000.json; it does not establish natural-language quality.
